description: Context Admission Layer (T2 504ca72e9; evaluated on frozen worktree 2f4c7daae)

context_bench.scenario: 303 + 9 memories, 131 queries (85 dev / 46 holdout), 24 expect abstention (8 in holdout); injection cap 10

t2_dev_selection.selection_rule: Per arm, on the 85 dev queries only: minimise context_pollution_rate subject to useful_memory_recall >= 0.85, ties broken by higher abstention_accuracy; if no setting reaches recall 0.85, maximise useful_memory_recall - context_pollution_rate. Remaining ties: higher useful_memory_recall, then higher auto threshold, then higher explicit threshold. Candidates: auto and explicit thresholds on the 0.30-0.90 grid (step 0.05) and, for E-det and F, the deterministic weights (the dev logistic fit; the same fit with class-balanced sample weights; the unweighted fit with its intercept shifted to a 50% prior; or the server's hand-set defaults). Metrics at the injection cap of 10.
deviations: Pass 1 (unweighted logistic fit and the hand-set defaults as weight candidates; chosen.json sha256 7eb77db5bcff1c8488f4bf11115ac75f827a51b8ab58db8d9199a7188bc9f3d5, superseded): the unweighted fit, calibrated to the 3.1% base rate of relevant candidates, cannot reach useful recall 0.85 anywhere in the pre-registered 0.30-0.90 grid (best 0.763 at 0.30), so E-det fell back to the hand-set defaults at the grid edge.

Pass 2 added the class-balanced fit (sample weights n / (2 n_class)) as a candidate (chosen.json sha256 1a8b76dcee4a2b01636b7933c896257e5b22421d5605e13816f25c678e1ae676, superseded). Its dev sweep was seen.

Pass 3 (this file) added the other textbook balanced-prior form, the unweighted fit with its intercept shifted by log(negatives / positives) (same ranking as the fit, read at a 50% prior), before it was scored; no further candidate is added. All passes used dev data only; no holdout query was run or read.
The deterministic weights of E-jev (used only when the decision model fails) are E-det's chosen weights; the selection rule does not weigh them.
